notes: Starting cards as marked '(st)': the Objective, Tatooine, Tatooine: Cantina, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Insurrection, Squadron Assignments and Staging Areas; these count toward the 60. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set. Total 60 as published.

The '(st)' marks mean starting, not Virtual: the Objective, Cantina, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Insurrection and Squadron Assignments are dested to the original Decipher cards (no (V) cards existed in March 2001).

Posted 'Sorry About The Bad English & Blaster Proficiency' dested Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency (dested as posted; the strategy repeats the same wording). Ounee Ta is the Effect (not the Reflections III shield).
Built by Jimmy Faelens with Julien Riviere; credited to Julien Riviere, who posted and played it (both played this version at Brugge).
player_note: The post (7 March 2001) says: 'Here is the version we both played at Brugge. I am proud to say I beat Bastian Winkelhaus and win the individual on Saturday with it.' The deck was first made and played by Jimmy Faelens and worked on with Julien Riviere; both played this version at the Decipher weekend in Brugge, Belgium.
